title: SFA Semicon
summary: Korean memory packaging and test supplier within the SFA group.
bodyHtml:
Investment Thesis

SFA Semicon packages and tests memory devices for Korean customers and operates overseas assembly capacity. The business is closely tied to memory production volumes and to the group's automation and equipment heritage. Margins are sensitive to utilisation and to memory pricing negotiations.

Technology Exposure

  • Memory assembly and test
  • Module assembly
  • Overseas packaging capacity

What To Watch

  • Memory production volumes
  • Utilisation and pricing
  • Group restructuring

Record Notes

Editorial brief compiled 19 November 2026 from company disclosures, agency publications and press reporting. Figures are as reported by those sources and have not been independently audited; no live market data is used.
